name: Undertone
author: Bharat Sharma (SattvicBeats)
description: Binaural-beat instrument: tanpura drone, taals, noise colours, weather, Om, breath pacer, sleep timer; visuals measured from the output incl. a solved Chladni plate; fullscreen screensaver. numpy engine → PipeWire.

barWidget.description: Play state + sleep-timer countdown. Click: show/hide panel. Middle-click: play/pause. Right-click: stop.
